name: zovo-html-css-class-intellisense
displayName: Class Names IntelliSense & CSS Support for HTML Templates (ID Completion)
description: Free and offline. CSS class names and id completion in HTML, React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, PHP and Blade, from every CSS, SCSS and Less file in your project, <style> blocks, linked style sheets and CSS modules. Go to definition and hover. Light on CPU in big monorepos.

htmlCssClass.languages.description: Language ids where class and id names complete. A change applies after a window reload.

htmlCssClass.exclude.description: Glob patterns of style sheets that are not indexed, on top of files.exclude and .gitignore. Sheets that a page links with <link rel="stylesheet"> are still read.

htmlCssClass.includePackages.markdownDescription: Packages in `node_modules` whose style sheets are indexed anyway, for example `bootstrap` or `@company/ui`.

htmlCssClass.useGitignore.description: Skip style sheets that the .gitignore file at the root of each workspace folder ignores.

htmlCssClass.maxFiles.description: The most style sheets to index. The index report says when it stops early.

htmlCssClass.maxFileSizeKB.description: Style sheets larger than this are skipped without being read, and the index report lists them.

htmlCssClass.maxNamesPerFile.description: The most class and id names read from one style sheet.

htmlCssClass.frameworks.description: Bundled class lists to add to completions, for pages that load Bootstrap or Bulma from a CDN. The lists ship with the extension; nothing is downloaded.

htmlCssClass.classFunctions.description: Functions whose string arguments hold class names, for example clsx("btn", on && "active").

htmlCssClass.suggestIds.description: Complete id names from the style sheets in id="..." attributes.

htmlCssClass.hover.description: Show the CSS rule and its file when the mouse is over a class name.

htmlCssClass.validate.description: Mark class names that no indexed style sheet defines, with a faint hint. Off by default: utility classes from other tools would show up too.

htmlCssClass.showStatusBar.description: Show the number of indexed classes in the status bar while a template file is open.

htmlCssClass.askForRating.description: Ask for a Marketplace rating after you used completions in 2 files, in 2 sessions at least 4 hours apart. "Later" asks one more time after 7 days, "No thanks" never asks again. It never asks after an error or more than 2 times. Nothing is sent anywhere.

htmlCssClass.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Rate, Sponsor and More free extensions links in the status bar tooltip. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Class Names IntelliSense
walkthroughs.description: Class and id names from your own style sheets, in every template language.

steps.title: Type a class name
steps.description:
Open an HTML, JSX, Vue, Svelte, PHP or Blade file and type inside class="..." or className="...". Names from every CSS, SCSS and Less file in the workspace show up, with the file they come from.
[Find a template file](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.html%22%5D)

media.altText: Class name completion in an HTML file, listing classes from the project style sheets.

steps.title: Hover and go to definition
steps.description: Hover a class name to see its CSS rule. F12 (Go to Definition) opens the rule in its style sheet.

steps.title: CSS modules, clsx and frameworks
steps.description: styles. completes from the imported module file. clsx(), cn() and cva() strings complete too. Pages that load Bootstrap or Bulma from a CDN can use the bundled class lists.

steps.title: Limits and excludes
steps.description:
node_modules, files.exclude and .gitignore are skipped. Set the file and size limits, or add packages to index.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22htmlCssClass%22%5D)

scripts.package: npm run build && npx -y @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/
